newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom, Havas in options deal.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom, Havas in options deal.

text.p: France Telecom and communications group Havas said on Wednesday they signed an agreement in which they granted each other call and put options for Oda shares.

If all the options are exercised, France Telecom will take control of Oda, a company which manages telephone directory administration in France and is currently controlled by Havas, a Havas spokeswoman said.
In a joint statement, the companies said the deal was aimed at developing the telephone directory market.

The reciprocal options, covering 100 percent of Oda's share capital, may be exercised from January 1, 2000 through December 31, 2003. The exercise price will be based on an expert appraisal with a minimum equal to the price set when France Telecom sold Oda shares to Havas in 1994, or 2.5 billion francs.
The two companies agreed to work to expand Oda's business until the exercise period begins, the statement said.
